comments: Hosted front end of the open-source MIT npm package motionspec (the same audit engine). Deliberately narrow scope: CSS/style-block motion against WCAG 2.2.2 and 2.3.3 only - not a full-page audit.
features: Free tool that statically scans a web page's linked CSS and style blocks for animation-accessibility issues: it flags motion that ignores prefers-reduced-motion and violations of WCAG 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide) and 2.3.3 (Animation from Interactions), returning a suggested fix for each finding. Motion scope only; nothing submitted is stored.
title: MotionSpec - Motion Accessibility Checker
